description: This file defines the MessageFormatInvalidException class, a specialized exception indicating validation failures in message formatting within the Eclipse Ditto framework. It includes mechanisms for constructing, serializing, and deserializing the exception, along with handling validation error details.

classes.name: MessageFormatInvalidException
classes.description: An exception class indicating validation errors specifically related to message formatting issues, including validation error details and JSON serialization/deserialization capabilities.
